plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: FamiliOS uses your approximate location to tailor local requests — weather, nearby places, and local news for your family. It never leaves your household's server.

plugins.photosPermission: FamiliOS asks for your photo library so you can attach a picture to a question, set a family member's profile photo, or add a document to your household's Library. Photos you pick go only to your household's own server.
plugins.cameraPermission: FamiliOS asks for the camera so you can photograph a document — a permission slip, an invoice, a school notice — straight into your household's Library. Nothing is captured unless you tap the shutter.

plugins.microphonePermission: FamiliOS uses the microphone to record voice notes for your family.
